name: kling
description: Generate AI videos with the Kling API through a local MCP connector.

interface.shortDescription: Generate videos with Kling text-to-video and image-to-video APIs.
interface.longDescription: A Kling API connector for creating asynchronous video generation tasks, checking task status, and waiting for generated video URLs.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 5 second cinematic video with Kling
Turn this image into a short Kling video
Check the status of my Kling video task

skillPreviews.name: Kling Video Generation
skillPreviews.description: Use when the user wants to generate, inspect, or wait for AI video generation tasks through the Kling API.

connectors.name: Kling API
connectors.description: Local MCP wrapper for Kling video generation APIs.
permissions: Starts a local Node.js MCP wrapper bundled with this plugin.
Sends prompts, public image URLs, or base64 image content to api-singapore.klingai.com.
Creates Kling generation tasks that may consume account credits or concurrency.

configFields.label: Kling API base URL
configFields.description: Override only if Kling documents a different API host for your account.

credential.label: Kling SecretKey
credential.description: Your Kling API SecretKey used to sign JWT requests.

tools.name: kling_health_check
tools.title: Kling Health Check
tools.description: Check whether Kling connector configuration is present.

tools.name: kling_create_text_to_video
tools.title: Create Text-to-Video
tools.description: Create a Kling text-to-video generation task.

tools.name: kling_create_image_to_video
tools.title: Create Image-to-Video
tools.description: Create a Kling image-to-video generation task.

tools.name: kling_get_video_task
tools.title: Get Video Task
tools.description: Fetch the current status and result URLs for a Kling video task.

tools.name: kling_wait_for_video
tools.title: Wait For Video
tools.description: Poll a Kling video task until it succeeds, fails, or times out.

tools.name: kling_list_video_tasks
tools.title: List Video Tasks
tools.description: List recent Kling video tasks for a supported video endpoint.

installReview: Requires a Kling AccessKey and SecretKey.
Generation tools can consume Kling account credits and concurrency.
Generated media URLs are returned by Kling and should be downloaded or transferred before they expire.
